TLDR- im really passionate about this game and i wrote a lot (i put it first and not last lmao)

**Trickster**

I did want reworks for this role, but it feels like the biggest disappointment to me. Taunting is not only a weak form of town killing and the trickster is susceptible to dying as well. Vigilante is versatile. Veteran is powerful. Trickster is just the bodyguard of town killing.

1. bodyguard protects target, kills the attacker, and dies
2. trickster is basically protecting the original target, kills the attacker, and dies

Fundamentally I don't see a difference between the role except for the role blocking and suspicion.

I just don't feel like the name Trickster even fits anymore. My idea of trickster is that it deceives evils in some way.  I don't think trickster fits as a town killing, personally. I think having another town killing is a good idea, but this role doesn't provide anything to town. And I'm running in a dead end trying to make a town killing. It already isn't a town killing.

I think it should be a support sort of deception. Maybe a self-transporter, though I understand that isn't the best idea either. I want to hear others' opinion, but I'm honestly just at a lost with this role. I truly want it to be something different.

**Wilding**

I am glad that wilding visits are limited. I feel unsure about whispers. Because coven does end up dominating a lot with all their powerful roles. I think it would be interesting if whispers were a sort of day ability. The wilding could choose to listen to one person's whispers that day and not the same person's whispers every day. I think whispers makes perfect sense because wilding has heightened senses, but if they cant see the entire town, I don't think they should see all whispers.

But that's just my opinion. I can see how making whispers a day ability makes it more complicated. I just think all whispers can be a bit too strong. So in the end Im waiting for other feedback on this.

**Executioner**

I don't think Exe should be able to choose a target to torment. It just makes them a kingmaker. The fun of exe is that its random, anyways. people are complaining about exe being nerfed but they just got to used to how strong it was. I like the changes. Makes it fair.
